title: First-pass and independent review rows may omit findings located on the reviewed path
observed_behavior: The validator proves that every finding ID claimed by an independent attestation exists, is located on the attested path, and exactly matches the first-pass set. It never derives the complete set of current findings located on each reviewed path or compares that set with the first-pass row. A live reconstruction returned zero issues while the W11 test first-pass row and attestation each listed 13 findings even though the current finding register located 17 findings on that test path; HIR-002 through HIR-005 were silently omitted from both evidence rows.
expected_invariant: For every achieved first-pass review row, finding_ids must exactly equal the set of current finding records whose locations include that path, using the same Windows case-insensitive identity model. Independent attestations must then exactly match that complete first-pass set and its current dispositions.
root_cause: Review-fragment validation performs existence and status consistency checks but receives only the global set of valid finding IDs, not a path-to-finding index. Independent validation enforces only one-way location membership for claimed IDs and equality with the already incomplete first-pass set.
failure_scenario: A reviewer omits one or more current path-local findings from both first-pass and independent evidence. Strict reconstruction and eventual completion pass, the file appears fully reviewed, and its second reviewer appears to have dispositioned every attached finding even though relevant defects were never acknowledged for that path. Multi-location P2/P3 findings can be omitted everywhere because the P0/P1 global attestation gate does not cover them.
evidence: review_fragment_findings lines 1494-1505 verifies only duplicate IDs, global existence, and status consistency.
second_review_attestation_findings lines 1601-1627 proves attestation equals first pass and each claimed ID is path-located, but never checks missing located IDs.
prepare_review_rows already builds a finding-ID-to-location map but passes it only to independent attestation validation.

At the ad2805d/d1cc lock, prepare_review_rows returned zero issues while a separate current-location join found HIR-002, HIR-003, HIR-004, and HIR-005 located on tests/python/tooling/test_repository_audit_ledger.py but absent from both its 13-ID first pass and 13-ID attestation.
existing_safeguards: Claimed first-pass finding IDs must exist.
Claimed independent finding IDs must be located on the attested path.
Independent and first-pass finding sets must match.
Every P0/P1 finding must be independently attested at at least one current location.
safeguard_gap: All safeguards are one-way or severity-global. None require a reviewed path to acknowledge every current finding located there, and P2/P3 omissions receive no independent global coverage check.
tests_present: Independent set-equality, path-membership, and P0/P1 coverage tests.
tests_missing: First-pass row missing one current path-local finding.
First-pass row claiming a finding located only on another path.
Deterministic prepare_review_rows rejection when first-pass and attestation agree on the same incomplete set.
recommended_remediation: Build a casefolded path-to-current-finding-ID index during review preparation and pass it into first-pass validation. Require each achieved review row's finding_ids to exactly equal the indexed set, with explicit missing and unexpected diagnostics. Keep the existing independent equality and disposition checks, and add focused unit plus live reconstruction tests.
remediation_risk: medium: the stronger join may expose legitimate but previously undocumented path-local links across older review fragments; those fragments must be reconciled rather than weakening the invariant
validation_rung: Focused audit-ledger unit tests for exact path-local sets, full 34-test suite, Ruff, py_compile, live non-mutating finding/error/review reconstruction, and distinct exact-hash W11 rereview.
prior_audit_relationship: New proof-gate defect discovered during the final W11 exact-location reconciliation after prior one-way binding hardening; the live W11 test row supplied the concrete false-completion witness.
